# Will your u-pick farm make money this season?

> Free planner for u-pick farms, pumpkin patches and agritourism. Enter days, visitors, admission, picking and extras; get break-even visitors, break-even admission, rainout risk and a profit grid. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
